claim: E1M4's carousel is nine type-617 rotating sectors (s321-329) turned as one body on one channel (rx 128): started once when the player first walks into sector 352 (trigger_enter, trigger_once, tx 128), retrigger at both ends, busy_time_a 255 (a whole slow turn, no way back). Its visible dressing (flat roof, poles, beasts: cstat 8577) rides by cstat 8192; the three gargoyles (type 206) and the pickup standing on it, and its 49 hidden gib objects, do not.
evidence: E1M4 sectors 321-329 (s321: type 617, rx 128, retrigger_a 1, retrigger_b 1, drag 1, busy_time_a 255)
E1M4 s352: the only sender on channel 128, trigger_enter and trigger_once (checked 2026-11-26); the carousel is not on the level-start channel 7
2026-11-26: of the 72 sprites in s321-329, 19 carry cstat 8192 (12 at 8577, 7 at 41376); not carried: gargoyles 816, 817, 1087 (type 206), pickup 1088 (type 105), 49 invisible type-416 objects
use: Turn a ride's platform, drum and neck about one axis with one time via bloodmap.mechanism.rigid_body, in its own ring of host.
